description: Use this to find a pay-per-call x402 API for a given task, network or price cap before calling it (mostly USDC on Base; check each row's network and asset, some are testnet or other assets). Searches a health-probed directory of live x402 pay-per-call HTTP endpoints on Base, Solana and other networks (x402_index_stats gives the current count). Returns id, resource URL, method, network, USD price, description, 30-day call/payer counts and our own uptime/probe data. Data is re-crawled a few times a day, not real-time. Quietforge operates this directory and also operates some listed endpoints (source=quietforge) under the same per-host cap as every operator; ordering is by 30-day usage, then liveness, then freshness, never by operator.

alive.description: true = answered its paid route on our last probe; false = did not; omit for both.
alive.title: Alive

limit.description: Page size, 1-100; out-of-range values are clamped.
limit.title: Limit

max_price_usd.description: Only endpoints priced at or below this USD amount per call; omit for any price.
max_price_usd.title: Max Price Usd

network.description: CAIP-2 network id to filter on, e.g. eip155:8453 (Base mainnet); omit for all networks.
network.title: Network

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging; negative is treated as 0.
offset.title: Offset

q.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the resource URL, description and service name; omit for no text filter.
q.title: Q

source.description: Listing source: cdp (Coinbase CDP bazaar), payai (PayAI discovery) or quietforge (our own endpoints); omit for all sources.
source.title: Source

name: x402_search
title: Search the x402 endpoint directory
